# Key-art generation prompts

Mode: OpenAI built-in image generation. No reference images were used for the
initial masters.

## Landscape master

Use case: `stylized-concept`. Public-launch landscape key art for a programming
puzzle game. An unnamed contemporary coastal city at midnight represented as a
calm municipal planning model, with two distinct possible histories layered
over the same streets and infrastructure. Premium cinematic editorial
illustration combining architectural model photography, archival paper,
restrained technical cartography, and subtle data visualization. Wide framing,
visual interest center/right, dark negative space left. Midnight navy, slate,
paper ivory, signal amber, causal cyan, restrained coral. No text, logos,
people, real city, puzzle answers, binary rain, neon cyberpunk, destruction,
explosions, or watermark.

A targeted edit replaced a red cross-like building emblem with a neutral
four-square municipal marker while preserving the composition.

## Portrait master

Use case: `stylized-concept`. Portrait poster art for the same launch. A coastal
city at midnight emerges from layered municipal maps and archival cards. Two
restrained luminous routes, cyan and amber-coral, split through the city and
meet at one neutral public record marker. Calm upper negative space for title,
paper and frosted causal layers below. No text, logos, people, protected
emblems, real city, puzzle answers, disaster spectacle, cyberpunk, binary code,
or watermark.
